needed.evidence: non-continuous and partly unusable sidewalk, informal paths with obstructions
needed.suggestion: Construct a continuous, usable sidewalk on the left side of the road with sufficient width and clear it of obstructions.

needed.evidence: Obstructions such as barriers and barriers-like items on the sidewalk
needed.suggestion: Remove all obstructions from the left sidewalk to ensure clear walkways for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: Broken or uneven sections on the footway
needed.suggestion: Repair and smooth out the trip hazards on the left sidewalk to provide a safer pedestrian environment.

needed.evidence: Marked zebra crossing without any refuge or proper crossing facility
needed.suggestion: Implement a refuge island or pedestrian signalisation to improve safety at the pedestrian crossing.

needed.evidence: Crossing is poorly marked and can be obstructed
needed.suggestion: Install better delineation and ensure the crossing is clear of obstructions to improve its quality.

needed.evidence: No dropped kerbs visible at the crossings
needed.suggestion: Add dropped kerbs or tactile paving at the crossing to alert drivers and pedestrians.
